mapper.insert: insert into tb_newbee_mall_goods_favorite (user_id, goods_id) select #{userId}, goods_id from tb_newbee_mall_goods_info where goods_id = #{goodsId} and goods_sell_status = #{sellStatusUp} on duplicate key update favorite_id = tb_newbee_mall_goods_favorite.favorite_id
mapper.delete: delete from tb_newbee_mall_goods_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tb_newbee_mall_goods_favorite where user_id = #{userId}
